subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should typed cron create and replace persist explicit announce delivery for `current` and named `session:` output jobs, matching CLI creation, raw normalization, and runtime planning?
rationale: The mismatch and code boundary are clear, but changing the serialized representation for existing typed callers is a compatibility choice requiring cron/session-target owner confirmation.

options.title: Align all creation paths
options.body: Approve explicit announce as the canonical stored default, retain the cron patch, and resolve the script conflict in favor of current main.

options.title: Preserve typed omission
options.body: Pause only if a supported typed caller or serialized-job consumer intentionally relies on omitted delivery being distinct from announce.
